line: Crowley's Two of Swords is the card for the first decan of Libra, with the Moon as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Libra.

quotes.quote: The Two of Swords was formerly called the Lord of Peace Restored
the celestial attribution: the Moon in Libra

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: This card is ruled by Chokmah in the Element of Air.
